description: Create, update, merge, or approve merge requests. Actions: create (new MR from source to target), update (title/description/assignees/reviewers/labels), merge (into target branch), approve/unapprove (review approval), get_approval_state (current approvals). Related: browse_merge_requests for discovery.

action.description: Action to perform: create, update, merge, approve, unapprove, get_approval_state

add_labels.description: Labels to add Required for 'update' action(s).

allow_collaboration.description: Let maintainers push to source branch Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

allow_maintainer_to_push.description: Deprecated - use allow_collaboration Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

assignee_id.description: Single assignee user ID Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

assignee_ids.description: Multiple assignee IDs Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

discussion_locked.description: Lock discussion thread Required for 'update' action(s).

labels.description: Labels to categorize MR Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

merge_commit_message.description: Custom merge commit message Required for 'merge' action(s).

merge_request_iid.description: Internal MR ID unique to project Required for 'update', 'merge', 'approve', 'unapprove', 'get_approval_state' action(s).

merge_when_pipeline_succeeds.description: Merge when pipeline succeeds Required for 'merge' action(s).

milestone_id.description: Associate MR with milestone Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

remove_labels.description: Labels to remove Required for 'update' action(s).

remove_source_branch.description: Auto-delete source branch after merge Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

reviewer_ids.description: User IDs for code reviewers Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

sha.description: SHA of head commit to approve specific version Required for 'merge', 'approve' action(s).

should_remove_source_branch.description: Remove source branch after merge Required for 'merge' action(s).

source_branch.description: Branch containing changes to merge Required for 'create' action(s).

squash.description: Combine all commits into one when merging Required for 'create', 'update', 'merge' action(s).

squash_commit_message.description: Custom squash commit message Required for 'merge' action(s).

state_event.description: State event: close or reopen Required for 'update' action(s).

target_branch.description: Branch to merge into Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

target_project_id.description: Target project for cross-project MRs Required for 'create' action(s).

name: manage_merge_request
